forms.identity_constraint: Silver-white hair, black headband, red-and-blue heterochromia, short layered black gothic corseted dress, dark stockings and tall dark boots. No invented ceremonial jewellery.

Long dark brown/black hair, cobalt-blue rose, violet teardrop marking, red-and-blue heterochromia, white fitted high-collar tunic/dress against dark lower garments, dark forearm wraps; retain distinctive silhouette, not a black gown.

Long white-silver with strong bright-blue streaks and asymmetry, red-and-blue heterochromia, black embellished gothic bodice and skirt, vivid red upper-stocking accents and dark stockings; do not add Grand wings.

Muted lavender-violet long hair, deep-red rose crown, red-and-blue heterochromia, black short gothic dress with center lacing/chain, one leg noticeably bandage-wrapped, other exposed; preserve asymmetry and bare feet where represented.

Muted violet-grey hair with red/blue highlights, dark facial marking, red-and-blue heterochromia, layered black-and-white dress, purple rose at waist, one wrapped leg, major dark-feathered and light inner wing structures; preserve wing topology, no invented crystal wing replacements.
